definitions.gloss: to welcome in; to receive; to accept into a group
definitions.explanation: To receive someone warmly into a place, organization, or group. Combines the nuance of going out to greet (迎える) with bringing them inside (入れる).

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}え{入|い}れた。
⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ホスト→ホスト：25722_hosuto⟧⟦ファミリー→ファミリー：11281_famirii⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{迎|むか}え{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To take in an exchange student as a host family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{温|あたた}かく→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧{迎|むか}え{入|い}れて⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{馴染|なじ}む→馴染む：14631_najimu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the warm welcome from the local people, I was able to fit in right away.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to go out to meet, to welcome) and ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put in, to let in). The combination emphasizes both the act of welcoming and the incorporation into a space or group.

ASPECT (ている):
{迎|むか}え{入|い}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes an ongoing state of having accepted someone into a group or place.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}え{入|い}れる (to welcome someone in)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}え{入|い}れる (to welcome a guest)
- ⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}え{入|い}れる (to accept a new member)
- ⟦{難民|なんみん}→難民：05313_nanmin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{迎|むか}え{入|い}れる (to take in refugees)
